messages:
rina: Thinking up a weird little weekend thing  blind soundtrack swap + 10min book excerpt. You pick a soundtrack (no context) and someone else pairs a short reading after listening. low-commitment, high mystery. whos in?
josh: way in. rules?
celia: yes! rule suggestion: max 10 tracks or a 30min side, no spoilers about why you chose it.
marcos: add: include 1 line hint (mood only). no plot spoilers.
rina: love both. mood hint only. example: "late-night commute, restless but hopeful"
playlist-bot: New event idea detected. Suggest creating collaborative playlist and an event stub. Would you like me to create a playlist? :robot_face:
leah: please create playlist + event. i'll help seed first tracks.
josh: ill take the first blind pick: Bandcamp mixtape -> dusty synths. mood hint: "empty diner at 2am"
celia: pairing candidate: short excerpt from Ottessa Moshfegh (5min). will DM the excerpt to whoever pairs me.
marcos: i'll pick a soundtrack: a cassette side of late-90s trip-hop (massive bass, slow breakbeats). hint: "rain on neon"
rina: ok i'm in. my pick will be a 7-track acoustic set (lo-fi) hint: "porch light, mismatched mugs"
playlist-bot: Collaborative playlist created: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/5BlindSwapExample. Event created: "Blind Soundtrack Swap + Readings" 1723543200 (Sat 7pm local).
leah: RSVP: yes. i'll seed with one of my favorite instrumental film cues as a curveball.
josh: code for pairing flow if people want to follow the structure: ```1) pick soundtrack + mood hint
2) upload to playlist or post link
3) someone else volunteers to pick a 5-10min reading that they think matches
4) share reactions after listening/reading (2 sentences max)```
celia: volunteer to pair joshs dusty synths with a snappy 8min short story about trains.
marcos: volunteer to pair rinas porch set with a quiet comic strip read (Calvin & Hobbes page).
rina: love it. can we do a quick reveal thread after the event where people post a 1-line "why it worked" reaction?
leah: yes please. tiny reveal only, keep the magic.
playlist-bot: Reminder set for participants at 1723540000 (1 hour before). Collaborative playlist link pinned to event.
josh: small logistics Q: do we want voice chat during the reveal or keep it text?
celia: text reveal is funnier imo. small voice optional for people who want to chat.
marcos: i'll bring a tiny set of tea + a biscuit for in-person folks.
rina: ok plan locked. saturday 7pm, blind soundtrack swap. thanks for making my week feel like a small festival. :sparkles:
leah: excited. will DM people who need file help (how to add local tracks to playlist etc.).
josh: pre-listen temptation will be high but i vow to wait. :sweat_smile:
playlist-bot: Participant list: [rina, josh, celia, marcos, leah]. Event reminder: 1723543200. :calendar:
